blogs.name: BusinessDay Nigeria
blogs.verificationMethod: Same feed already verified for Agriculture, Dentistry, and Carpentry — cross-tagged here because BusinessDay has run a specific, real feature on Nigeria's leather shoe industry (the Aba Leather Cluster, 70,000+ shoemakers, $800M market, AfCFTA export growth).

notes: IMPORTANT SAFETY FINDING from this round: articles.connectnigeria.com, which had looked like a strong lead for an earlier category (Event Decoration & Planning) and appeared again in this category's search results, was fetched directly and returned a page full of injected gambling/casino spam content instead of real articles — a strong sign the domain has been compromised or expired and repurposed. Not used here or anywhere else; the earlier category's notes have been corrected to reflect this. On channels: Aba (Nigeria's shoemaking capital, 70,000-100,000+ shoemakers) has extensive documentary/travel-vlog YouTube coverage of the industry, but no dedicated business-of-shoemaking channel surfaced — the closest lead, a Nigerian-born shoemaker featured by APT in Frankfurt, is a news feature about him, not his own channel. African Cobblers Resource Centre (a real Aba-based footwear training company) is worth a closer look in a future pass — no clear YouTube presence found this round, but the training-business angle fits well.
